description: Stereo channel strip: three-band EQ, pan, mute and a voltage-controlled level, with a limiter on the output

params.text: Lifts or cuts a low shelf at 125Hz, -20dB to 20dB
Lifts or cuts a peaking band at 1200Hz, -12.5dB to 12.5dB
Lifts or cuts a high shelf at 2000Hz, -15dB to 15dB
Places the signal between left and right
Mutes the channel: a click toggles the mute, dragging up unmutes it, and dragging down unmutes it only while the mouse is held
Attenuates the pan CV input, from nothing through to its full effect
Adds 6dB of gain before the EQ and the VCA

inputs.text: The left side of the signal, and with nothing patched on the right it feeds both sides in mono
Scales the level, 0-10V from silence to whatever the level knob sets; with nothing patched the level is whatever the knob says
The right side of the signal; with nothing patched here the left input feeds both sides
Moves the signal between left and right, -5V to 5V covering the whole sweep, after the pan CV attenuator and added to the pan knob

outputs.text: The left side of the finished signal
The right side of the finished signal

notes: with the module bypassed each input is passed straight to the output on its own side
the level knob comes up fully down at -60dB, so nothing audible reaches the outputs until it is turned up.
menu: Apply Highpass (25Hz) — puts a 25Hz high-pass filter on the signal; on by default
Panning law — picks how the level is shared across the pan sweep: Linear (+6dB), Equal power (+3dB) or Linear clipped
Apply Highshelf (12kHz) — puts a 12kHz high shelf on the signal; on by default
Apply soft-clipping — saturates the output rather than letting it run past its limit; on by default
